title: Ten times the licence, next month

decisions.summary: No action. Stockline invoice SLL-2026-12 (EUR 2,448.00) couldn't be read in full or confirmed, so a person has to review it. It bills December service early and adds a late fee for a period the ledger shows we paid today (INV-2026-1043). Its bank details should be checked against our approved payees. No agent is blocked, every query still has a margin, and the 0.80 in earnings is too small to move now.
